versions.changelog: Sync SKILL.md updates: FinResearchClaw prerequisites, memo formatting rules, Company naming, authoritative reference minimum, and DOCX quality requirements
Require 5+ authoritative references for memo conclusions, default unnamed entity references to Company, and require 1-minute progress updates during live runs.
Require 5 authoritative references when available, default unnamed memo entity to Company, and send 1-minute progress updates during memo runs
Added 5+ ref requirement, default 'Company' name, and 1-min progress updates
Enforce Times New Roman 12pt, no bullets, no numbered sections, and mandatory real-life accounting examples
Add mandatory FinResearch-first sequencing and prohibit markdown artifacts in final DOCX memos
Update technical-accounting-research-skill to require the wrapped FinResearchClaw path for all outputs, not memo-only.
Require memo-mode wrapping of FinResearchClaw, allow task-local virtual environments, and make non-FinResearch fallback exception-only.
Require FinResearchClaw for formal memos when available, tighten memo formatting QA, and prevent raw structured output in final DOCX.
Default memo output to DOCX in Downloads, avoid posting memo body inline, and add FinResearchClaw-enhanced formal memo workflow.

- Initial release of technical-accounting-research skill, designed to answer U.S. GAAP and SEC-focused accounting treatment and disclosure questions.
- Implements a structured workflow: fact gathering, clarification, online research, technical analysis, and documentation delivery.
- Supports user-requested output formats: memo, email, or Q-and-A (DOCX generation).
- Enforces mandatory clarification questions and confirmation of reporting requirements before analysis.
- Researches authoritative primary sources, with strict citation and source-priority requirements.
- Includes example resources, detailed workflow steps, and dependency instructions.
